label: Wedding Vendor
description: Wedding photographers, decorators, caterers, planners, makeup artists, banquet and event vendors.

headlineKpi.label: New reviews per week
headlineKpi.help: Wedding buyers read the most recent season only. Reviews older than one season carry very little weight.

issueTaxonomy.label: Final delivery delayed
issueTaxonomy.action: Put a dated delivery commitment in every contract and send a written status update at the halfway point.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how long you have been waiting for the final files
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: final files milne mein hui deri

issueTaxonomy.label: Output did not match the samples shown
issueTaxonomy.action: Show only work your current team actually shot or produced, and name the lead person assigned to the booking in the contract.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the work not matching what you were shown
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: kaam waisa na hone jaisa dikhaya gaya tha

issueTaxonomy.label: Different team turned up on the day
issueTaxonomy.action: Name the exact lead crew in the contract and get written consent before any substitution.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: a different team turning up on the day

issueTaxonomy.label: Poor communication before the event
issueTaxonomy.action: Schedule one written check-in at booking, one at minus 30 days and one at minus 3 days for every event.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how hard it was to reach us

issueTaxonomy.label: Costs added later
issueTaxonomy.action: Itemise every inclusion and exclusion in the quote, and refuse to add a charge that is not in the signed contract.

issueTaxonomy.label: Late arrival on the day
issueTaxonomy.action: Require the crew to arrive one hour before call time and confirm arrival to the client by message.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: arriving later than we should have

issueTaxonomy.label: Missed key moments / coverage gaps
issueTaxonomy.action: Agree a written shot or coverage list with the client at minus 7 days and assign one person to tick it off live.

issueTaxonomy.label: Behaviour on the day
issueTaxonomy.action: Brief the crew on guest conduct and dress code, and name one on-site lead who owns all client contact.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: how the team behaved on the day

issueTaxonomy.label: Edits / revisions refused
issueTaxonomy.action: State the number of included revisions in the contract and honour them without argument.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the changes you asked for not being made

issueTaxonomy.label: Advance not refunded on cancellation
issueTaxonomy.action: Escalate offline immediately. Put the cancellation and refund slab in writing before accepting any advance.
issueTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the delay in returning your advance
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: advance wapas milne mein hui deri
issueTaxonomy.replyPhraseMarathi: आगाऊ रक्कम परत मिळण्यास झालेल्या उशिराबद्दल

praiseTaxonomy.label: Excellent final output
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: you are happy with how the work turned out

praiseTaxonomy.label: Professional, calm team
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: the team handled the day well
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: team ne din acche se sambhala

praiseTaxonomy.label: Clear communication
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: you were kept in the loop

praiseTaxonomy.label: Flexible and accommodating
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: hum aapke hisaab se adjust kar paaye

praiseTaxonomy.label: Fair pricing for the work
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhrase: it felt worth what you paid
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: kharche ke hisaab se theek laga

praiseTaxonomy.label: Delivered on time
praiseTaxonomy.replyPhraseHinglish: sab kuch time par pahunch gaya

voicePreset.greeting: Thank you for taking the time to write this.
exampleReplies: Thank you for telling us. A delivery running past the date we committed is on us. Please message the office directly and we will give you a firm date in writing.
Thank you — it was a privilege to be part of the day.

staffAskScript.when: At final delivery, once the client has seen and approved the finished work.
staffAskScript.line: If we did right by you, an honest review helps the next couple choose with confidence. The QR on the delivery card takes a minute.
staffAskScript.hinglishLine: Agar humne aapke liye theek kaam kiya ho, toh ek honest review agle couple ko confidence dene mein help karta hai. Delivery card ka QR ek minute lega.
staffAskScript.marathiLine: आमचं काम तुम्हाला आवडलं असेल, तर प्रामाणिक अभिप्राय पुढच्या जोडप्याला आत्मविश्वासाने निवडायला मदत करतो. डिलिव्हरी कार्डवरचा QR एक मिनिट घेतो.
doNot: Never offer a discount, free prints or extra edits in exchange for a review.
Never ask only the clients whose events went perfectly.
Never write a review on a client's phone.
Never ask a client to remove or edit a review.
Never post or mention client photos, names or venue details in a public reply.

profileGapChecks.label: No price range indicated anywhere public

contentTemplates.label: Reply — delivery delay
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you for telling us. A delivery running past the date we committed is on us. Please message the office directly and we will give you a firm date in writing.

— {{businessName}}

contentTemplates.label: Reply — positive review
contentTemplates.body:
Thank you — it was a privilege to be part of your day. Wishing you both the very best.

— {{businessName}}
